newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EASC chair seeks immediate surcharge removal.
newsitem.headline: EASC chair seeks immediate surcharge removal.

text.p: The new chairman of the European Air Shippers' Council (EASC) has called for an immediate withdrawal of the fuel surcharges introduced by the airlines.
Recently-appointed EASC chairman, Knut Hansen, said that there appears to be growing evidence of concerted action over the surcharge.

"EASC is very concerned at the recent imposition of fuel surcharges by the airline industry. The universal imposition of a ten U.S. dollar cents or equivalent surcharge is unjustified and is an inappropriate way of dealing with cost increases," he said.
The shippers' group said that all appropriate steps will be taken with the authorities to protect shippers from abusive or anti-competitive industry practices.

"My key objective is to ensure that real progress is now made towards improvements in service standards and in the fostering of closer relationships with freight forwarders, integrators and airlines to achieve this," Hansen stated.

A key to promoting genuine partnerships is establishing a European Cargo Industry Forum. There had been an encouraging response from all sectors of the air cargo industry concerning this initiative, he added. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
